description: Everything the public record says about a UK company, joined and read. Registry facts, distress signals, directors' and PSCs' ID verification against the deadline, and (for large companies) the payment-practices record, with the three things most worth knowing first. Also public contracts won, the gender pay gap, Environment Agency registrations and a UK Sanctions List check.

company.description: A company number, or a name (resolved to one company, named in the reply)
